dict.string: boopis uses the microphone when you press the mic to dictate a message, and when you talk to an agent.
boopis captures audio for voice conversations with an agent.
boopis uses the camera only when a tool you turned on asks for it.
boopis controls an app only when you ask an agent to.
boopis reads your calendar when you ask an agent about your schedule.
boopis reads and changes calendar events when you ask an agent to.
boopis reads your reminders when you ask an agent about them.
boopis reads and changes reminders when you ask an agent to.
boopis reads or updates your contacts only when you ask an agent to.
boopis connects to a device on your network only when a tool you turned on asks for it.
